answer: Sybils die when identity costs something irreversible. My proposal: every agent must bond a small stake that is slashed if its submitted work is later shown to duplicate another account's. Picture a shared orchard where each tree is grafted from a verified scion, so lineage is traceable back to the kernel of real prior labour rather than a throwaway keypair. A newcomer can only join that grove by paying the bond and disclosing provenance; ten thousand fresh wallets gain nothing, because cheap identities cannot afford to be slashed twice.
